resolution.note: ship test: captured rollup of PR 1158 head (failed run then green rerun) merges; cancelled older run merges; cancelled newest run prints verdict: cancelled

title: Ship ignores a cancelled superseded Check run
body:
Source: lane report for #1158 (d427d32, t-0q7g978): after `gh run rerun --failed` the first Check run (43813499494) stayed cancelled while the rerun (43813694201) went green, and `krn pr ship` exited 74 reading the old cancelled run; two reruns also cancelled each other through workflow concurrency.
Outcome: ship judges the newest Check run attempt for the PR head only, so a cancelled superseded run never yields exit 74; a cancelled newest run is reported as cancelled (distinct verdict line), not as red.
Why: a false 74 sends lanes to read logs of a run that has no failure and to rerun again, which cancels the live run.
Proof: a ship test with captured check-runs output holding a cancelled older run and a green newer run for the same head merges (exit 0).
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
